summary_1line: Anxious Dhritarashtra summons Vidura, who rebukes him and delivers extensive teachings on wisdom, folly, kingship, restraint, and moral conduct.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sleepless blind king Dhritarashtra sits in a dim palace chamber while the calm Vidura stands before him offering stern counsel.
Vidura, hands folded, addresses the troubled king seated on his throne as attendants wait silently in the shadowed hall.
The wise counselor Vidura speaks firmly while the blind monarch leans forward anxiously, tormented by thoughts of the coming message from the Pandavas.
